description: RWS · Celtic cross (lite) · open reflection, no note, deep depth.

detail: What would change if you treated The Star as describing you rather than the situation?
Which of these cards felt truest the moment you saw it, before you read anything?

output.synthesis: Taken together, these cards suggest that what you are sitting with may be less about a decision than about what The Star in the The heart of the matter position is asking you to notice.

per_card.text: In the The heart of the matter position, The Star may point to hope as one thread running through what you are sitting with. One way to read this is as a question rather than an answer: what would hope look like here, in practice?
nuances: Read another way, The Star here might describe how the situation feels from the inside rather than what it is.

output.combined: Read as a whole, the The Star, Five of Cups, The Emperor, Page of Swords, Ten of Pentacles seem to describe a movement from hope toward something you have not named yet. The cards do not settle the question; they suggest where it might be worth looking. It may help to hold the reading loosely and return to it once something has moved.
